text: The purpose of this report is to seek instruction for a matter before the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT).

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 6, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix A to the report (June 6, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 6, 2022) from the City Solicitor remain confidential, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
